summary:
A chargeback week. Two fans charged back $2.4k (9/26) and $1.7k (9/28), $4.1k in three days, in a month she had already said was down. She flagged both herself ('This one is for $1.7k! Whats going on?'). This is the second chargeback cluster since June, when she lost over $7k, including one $7,593 chargeback. Noah handled it well. He replied within 31 minutes both times, got the fan to explain himself, put together screenshots for her OnlyFans dispute, and won the $1.7k fan back the same afternoon. One problem with that save: Noah gave the fan her personal Snapchat as a sweetener ('I sent him ur snap too had to offer it as extra to get him back'). She had agreed to share it with a different fan on 9/25, not this one.

She was engaged, warm and quick: 16 messages, all of them yes, done or thank you. Before 9/25 she had been silent for 8.5 days, and so had the whole chat (nobody posted between 9/17 and 9/25, so there were no findings for the 9/25 week). Melissa's new account brought back the weekly leak-removal recap on 9/25, 17 days after Michelle's last one. Melissa also sent the agency-wide intake-form link on 9/28. Hailey has not replied to it in the chat.

Nothing structural moved. On 10/1 Stephski issued the Sep 15-30 invoice, the fourth in a row that does not confirm any of the three earlier wires (8/20, 9/7, 9/16). There was also no OF-withdrawal reminder the day before this time. No revenue plan was posted, the private live she agreed to on 9/14 is still unscheduled, and nobody has touched the .vip domains (110 days) or the IG shadowban (65 days). Derrek has posted nothing since 8/20. Churn watch: none of the four signals. She is not short with the team, has not asked for exports or logins, and has not mentioned another agency. The 10/1 invoice is not yet paid, so fast payment cannot be judged yet. She is still not replying to ALTR's own asks: the Facebook login (15 days), the 8/30 content quota and the 9/4 call.

health.rationale: Up 1 from 56, which is effectively flat. On the plus side: ALTR answered fast and owned the problem on the two biggest events of the week (Noah replied in 28 and 31 minutes, explained what happened, prepared dispute evidence and recovered a fan). She is still warm and involved ('Thank u so much!!!', 'Keep me posted 🙏'), and the leak recap is back after 17 days. On the minus side: $4.1k of chargebacks in a month she already said was down, the second cluster since June. The 10/1 invoice went out with the 8/20, 9/7 and 9/16 wires still unconfirmed and no plain-text banking details. The revenue plan and private live from 9/13-14 have not moved. Derrek has been silent since 8/20. Every structural item is another week older. ALTR also gave her personal Snapchat to a chargeback fan as a concession without asking her. No churn signals this week: she is not quiet or short, has not asked for data or logins, and has not mentioned other agencies or doing it herself. The 10/1 invoice is still open, so fast payment cannot be judged yet.

client_priorities: Revenue protection - chargebacks are her loudest topic again. She flagged $2.4k and $1.7k in three days, asked 'Whats going on?', and offered to dispute ('Can we screenshot that and show only fans'). This is the second cluster after June's $7k+. Two clusters in four months means a written process, not one-off saves.
Noah: ask before sharing her personal Snapchat with any fan. Tell her the 9/28 fan has it, and ask whether she is OK with Snap being used as a retention offer from now on.

Stephski: before the 10/8 due date, send one message confirming the 8/20, 9/7 and 9/16 wires (amount and receiving account) and post the canonical banking details as plain text, naming which saved recipients she should delete. Bring back the day-before OF-withdrawal reminder for the 10/15 cycle.

Derrek: one owner message this week, covering the phone-farm update promised 8/1, who her point of contact is, and an acknowledgement of the chargeback hit. Nothing from the owner since 8/20.

She agreed to every ask this week within a minute (Snap add, custom, dispute email). She is cooperative, warm and present after an 8.5-day silence.
